Class RoutePathVariables

java.lang.Object
io.micronaut.http.bind.MatchedPathVariables
io.micronaut.web.router.RoutePathVariables
All Implemented Interfaces:
NamedValues, PathVariables
Direct Known Subclasses:
DefaultPathVariables
@Internal public class RoutePathVariables extends MatchedPathVariables
The PathVariables of a route match, which fail like the path variable arguments of a controller method: a missing variable with an UnsatisfiedPathVariableRouteException.

5.3.0
